The '''Gradient Seven corrections facility''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] detention [[Moon/Legends|moon]] known as [[Gradient Seven]]. The prison was slated to receive a new group of prisoners from the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], but the vessel broke down in deep space and was unable to complete its journey.
